prompts.stone: Create a single seamless gray stone paving tile using reference palette and hand-painted material. At left and right edges the paving course heights must match exactly. Top and bottom rows must match exactly. Make all boundaries continuous without cutting off unrelated stones. Uniform diffuse light, top-down flat opaque surface, similar small detail scale. Prefer a simpler genuinely repeatable layout over irregular disconnected border slabs. No rim, rectangular tile border, perspective, blocks, grid overlay, text or UI. One square texture only.

Treat image as a torus, including corners. Output one square opaque orthographic top-down diffuse-lit seamless water texture. No shoreline, border, frame, grid, perspective, UI or text. Rearrange interior ripples as needed to make genuine seamless wrapping.
